evidence.quote: A VideoCardz source confirmed that one board partner already has RTX 50 Super GPUs on hand, but Nvidia has allegedly told the company that the products are on hold because of the price of 3GB GDDR7 memory chips.
evidence.one_line: Unnamed VideoCardz source says a board partner has RTX 50 Super GPUs on hand, and Nvidia allegedly said the launch is on hold over 3GB GDDR7 memory prices.
evidence.speaker: VideoCardz source (unnamed)

evidence.quote: Nvidia used to supply VRAM chips alongside GPU dies to its board partners, but it changed this policy in late 2025 as the memory chip crisis unfolded.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia stopped supplying VRAM chips with GPU dies to board partners in late 2025; partners must now source memory themselves.
evidence.speaker: Jowi Morales (tomshardware.com)

evidence.quote: The RTX 50 Super GPUs are rumored to have 3GB GDDR7 chips , which offers 50% more capacity than the 2GB found in current-gen RTX 50-series graphics cards.
evidence.one_line: RTX 50 Super GPUs are rumored to use 3GB GDDR7 chips, 50% more capacity than the 2GB in current RTX 50 cards.
evidence.speaker: Jowi Morales (tomshardware.com)

evidence.quote: Unfortunately, these chips cost twice or thrice as much as their 2GB variants, which will likely push the retail price of these cards beyond Nvidia’s envisioned MSRP.
evidence.one_line: 3GB GDDR7 chips reportedly cost two to three times as much as 2GB variants, likely pushing RTX 50 Super retail prices above Nvidia's MSRP.
evidence.speaker: Jowi Morales (tomshardware.com)

evidence.quote: SK hynix, one of the big three memory chip manufacturers, even says that 2027 is set to be the “worst year” for the memory shortage and said that the crunch will last until 2030.
evidence.one_line: SK hynix says 2027 will be the worst year for the memory shortage and the crunch will last until 2030.
evidence.speaker: SK hynix

evidence.quote: with memory accounting for 25% of the BOM, as costs have soared by nearly 500%.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia's latest AI systems reportedly have memory at 25% of bill of materials, with costs up nearly 500%.
evidence.speaker: Jowi Morales (tomshardware.com)

evidence.quote: the company not announcing a new GPU at CES 2026
evidence.one_line: Nvidia did not announce a new GPU at CES 2026, the first time in five years.
evidence.speaker: Jowi Morales (tomshardware.com)

candidates.question: Will Nvidia publicly launch RTX 50 Super series GPUs by 2027-02-28?

rungs.label: Yes
rungs.condition: Nvidia officially launches at least one RTX 50 Super GPU by 2027-02-28

rungs.label: No
rungs.condition: No RTX 50 Super GPU is officially launched by 2027-02-28

candidates.settled_by: Nvidia official product announcement or launch record
